"""A FlowSim model drawn in the model builder. Edit it like any FlowSim script."""

from flowsim import Model, exponential

model = Model(time_unit="minutes")
customers = model.source(
    name="Customers",
    interarrival=exponential(mean=4),
)
desk = model.station(
    name="Desk",
    capacity=1,
    service_time=exponential(mean=4),
)
exam = model.station(
    name="Exam",
    capacity=1,
    service_time=exponential(mean=4),
)
model.route([customers, desk, exam, model.exit])

results = model.run(
    duration=240,
    seed=42,
)
print(results)
